newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cheung Kong raises loan to HK$3.96 bln.
newsitem.headline: Cheung Kong raises loan to HK$3.96 bln.

text.p: Cheung Kong unit Cheung Kong Finance Co's five-year term loan facility has been increased to HK$3.96 billion from HK$3.6 billion in the underwriting phase, arranger Societe Generale said.
The underwriting group was closed with total underwriting commitments of HK$6.150 billion from 20 banks, representing an oversubscription of 70 percent.
BA Asia, CIBC CEF, Hang Seng Finance and Societe Generale Asia are co-ordinating arrangers.

The Hong Kong branches of Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi, Banque Nationale de Paris, Commerzbank, Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank, Sakura Bank, Standard Chartered Bank, Sumitomo Bank, Bayerische Hyopotheken, Deutsche Bank, Fuji Bank, Industrial Bank of Japan and Tokai Bank are arrangers.
The Hong Kong branches of Long-term Credit Bank of Japan, Mitsubishi Trust and Banking Corp, Sanwa Bank and Toyo Trust and Banking Co are co-arrangers.
